title: Key-value store script
description: Run a script of commands on a store that starts empty and maps keys (Text) to numbers (Int). Each command has an op, a key and a number n; commands are numbered from 1. `set` stores n under the key. `add` adds n to the key's value, treating a missing key as 0, and stores the result. `get` prints `KEY = V` when the key has a value and `KEY: unset` otherwise. `del` removes the key and prints nothing; if the key has no value it prints `nothing to delete: KEY` instead. `dump` prints one line `KEY=V` for every entry, in the order the keys were first inserted, or the single line `(empty)` when the store has no entries; key and n are ignored. Any other op prints `command N: bad op OP` and changes nothing (ops are case-sensitive). Insertion order: setting or adding to a key that already has a value keeps its place; a key that was deleted and is set again goes to the end. n is ignored by get, del and dump, and key is ignored by dump. Return the number of keys left at the end.
notes: Level 3. Needs an insertion-ordered map: a plain unordered hash map gives wrong dump order (Rust HashMap, unordered containers). Re-setting keeps the position; delete-then-set moves to the end; add on a missing key creates it at the end; `del` of a missing key prints a message; empty key is a valid key (get prints ` = V`); ops are case-sensitive. Largest value 9e15.
